::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 5th 1880  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne,Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.
:::

My dear [Mr Moor](people/person_1046.qmd)

Thank you much. I send the papers. I have hopes for this time, if there is no fresh very sad case in the way. I cannot call this case like a very bad one of great poverty though I should be exceedingly glad if it succeeded[^1]

I enclose my subscription

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This letter seems to be concerned with voting for a candidate for charity.
